messages:
Maria (support): FYI customer-x opened a ticket — massive p99 regression on /v1/generate after last night's batching deploy. They saw 504s and p99 jumping from ~180ms to up to ~1.2s. attach: repro and trace id trace/abc123

Ian (eng-sre): thanks. can you paste trace id and traffic pattern? want to check batcher wait histograms + kv-cache hit rate

Maria (support): trace id trace/abc123. Repro notes: lots of tiny prompts (~8-15 tokens), sustained ~100-150 RPS, single route. No auth or billing issues. They started seeing this right after deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy 2023-11-20T22:03:45Z by @alex — continuous-batcher v2.1, hold_window tuned up

Alex (infra): we increased hold_window to reduce token fragmentation for long contexts. roll back is quick if this is the culprit but want to confirm first.

Ian (eng-sre): pulling metrics now. route-level p95 up modestly, p99 exploded (~3-6x). batcher wait_time shows a distinct mode around 300-800ms for a subset of requests. looks like requests are sitting in the batcher longer than before.

Ian (eng-sre): sample logs from gpu-node g-23:
```
batcher: recv req=req-0a1 size=12
batcher: hold_window=300ms waiting
batcher: timeout release batch_size=1
infer: kv-cache miss path
```
Those single-request releases explain the high tail.

Liz (customer-success): customer insists they didn't change anything client-side. They want ETA and whether we can route them to backup while we fix. Theyre pretty anxious.

Ian (eng-sre): config that went live:
```
continuous_batcher:
  hold_window_ms: 300
  max_batch_size: 64
  min_batch_size: 2
  tiny_wait_threshold_ms: 50
```
Increasing hold_window helped long-context throughput but harms tiny prompt heavy routes — H-O-L (head-of-line) waits grow.

Alex (infra): proposal: add an automatic low-latency profile for routes with median_prompt_length < 30 and qps > 50: hold_window_ms=20, max_batch_size=8. We can target the config at route level via control plane.

Ian (eng-sre): repro locally with customer's pattern and reproduced. With hold_window=300 we get p99 ~800ms; with hold_window=20 p99 back to ~210ms. Will prepare hotfix and targeted rollback.

Maria (support): customer asked if we can rollback their route immediately. They can divert to backup if needed.

Alex (infra): initiating targeted canary rollback for org=customer-x to old profile (hold_window=20). Doing per-route canary now.

deploy-bot: canary apply config to route org=customer-x at 2023-11-21T11:05:12Z

Ian (eng-sre): monitoring after canary: p95 ~baseline, p99 dropped from ~900ms to ~230ms within ~4 minutes. no 504s seen in last 5m. Nice.

Maria (support): customer confirmed improvement, says thank you. they want a short postmortem and assurance this won't reoccur.

Liz (customer-success): action item: schedule postmortem with infra/runtime/product to revisit defaults and guardrails. also cc CS on timeline for customer note.

Ian (eng-sre): follow-ups I'm taking:
- add a per-route classifier to select batching profile based on median prompt length, qps, and observed batch_size distribution
- add alert: if p99 > baseline*3 AND batcher.wait_time_p95 > 100ms for > 5m -> pager
- add guardrail preventing hold_window_ms > 100 for routes with median_prompt_length < 40
- document canary/rollback CLI for per-tenant batching profiles
- create INC-20231121-batcher-p99 and draft blameless postmortem

Alex (infra): I'll implement the per-route quick-rollback CLI and a control-plane flag to force low-latency profile. will also add a test in our deploy pipeline to detect large hold_window flips.

Maria (support): I updated the support ticket with timeline, repro, and mitigation notes. CS will send an update to customer and offer 24h monitoring dashboard access.

Liz (customer-success): customer asked for SLA reassurance. Maria/ Ian, can we add temporary monitoring and a note that we rolled back their route and are watching for 24h?

Ian (eng-sre): done — pushed a small dashboard to the org, set a 24h intensive alert window.

Alex (infra): also adding a small runtime guard: if a route's recent avg_batch_size < 4 and qps > 40, auto-set tiny_wait_threshold_ms to 20 until metrics stabilize.

Maria (support): customer happy for now, will close the ticket after 24h of stability. thanks everyone.

Ian (eng-sre): will write up postmortem and proposed default changes. tagging product/runtime for prioritization. closing thread once PM review lands.

-- end of thread --
